description: One line per paid (or free-tier) model invocation. Append-only. The running_total_usd enforces the hard cap: halt before any call that would exceed it.

cost_usd.description: Actual billed cost for this call, USD.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens billed (null when the provider does not report, e.g. headless baseline).

model.description: Model slug as invoked (or RESOLVE_AT_RUNTIME note for free-tier resolution).

running_total_usd.description: Cumulative spend including this call. HALT if a planned call would push this over the authorized cap.

task_id.description: Unique id for this invocation (links to the escalation-contract record).
